notes: Read all 242 numbered source lines before editing. This is a non-visual logic/data module (no JSX, no DOM, no React state, no API path, no unit handling): the REGISTRY map, the FALLBACK descriptor, and the getActivityVisual() prefix-walk resolver are ported faithfully.

L1-11 file-level JSDoc (audit_logs.action -> visual + i18n key for the per-user activity feed; best-effort domain.verb / domain.entity.verb prefix walk; always render with a generic fallback icon) preserved verbatim, followed by a native-safety header documenting the two browser-only boundaries.

L13 `import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react'` + L14 `import { Icons } from '@/lib/icons'` dropped — both browser-only. Replaced by a single type-only `import type { SemanticIconName } from '../../components/icons/SemanticIcon'`. The component-typed `icon: LucideIcon` field becomes `iconName: SemanticIconName` (the established native idiom from CommandSelectDialog.tsx / featureCatalog.ts / registry/battery.ts). Every web `Icons.<key>` used here (gamepad, power, notificationsActive, locked, unlocked, climate, bolt, settings, notificationsAdd, notifications, notificationsMuted, workflow, layoutGrid, layoutDashboard, download, key, user, history) maps 1:1 to the identically-named SemanticIconName, so the chosen icon per action is preserved exactly.

L16-25 export interface ActivityVisual ported field-for-field — `icon: LucideIcon` -> `iconName: SemanticIconName`; color/i18nKey/fallback unchanged; all four doc comments preserved (the icon comment updated to note the LucideIcon->SemanticIcon adaptation).

L27-217 const REGISTRY: Record<string, ActivityVisual> ported byte-for-byte for all 29 entries across the 7 section banners (Vehicle commands L28, Settings/preferences L78, Alerts L92, Automations L118, Dashboard/layout L144, Data exports L158, API keys L172, Auth L198): every color Tailwind class (text-fuchsia-400, text-amber-300, text-yellow-300, text-emerald-300, text-sky-300, text-indigo-300, text-rose-300, text-cyan-300, text-violet-300, text-teal-300, text-[var(--text-muted)]) is kept verbatim, and every i18nKey + English fallback string reproduced exactly. Tailwind color classes are intentionally retained as the web featureCatalog.ts idiom does (a native consumer maps them to a tint at the render boundary). Bare-identifier keys (settings, alert, automation, dashboard, data_export, api_key, auth) are unquoted by prettier quoteProps:as-needed while dotted keys stay quoted — the runtime lookup values are unchanged.
L219-224 const FALLBACK: ActivityVisual ported verbatim (iconName 'history', color text-[var(--text-muted)], i18nKey activity.action.unknown, fallback 'Activity').

L226-242 getActivityVisual(action) JSDoc (L226-230) preserved; the resolver body is logically identical: empty-string guard returns FALLBACK; exact REGISTRY[normalized] (after trim()) hit returns it; otherwise the parts = normalized.split('.') prefix walk from i = parts.length-1 down to i>0 (slice(0,i).join('.')) returns the first matching prefix, else FALLBACK. Single-line `if (...) return ...` statements were wrapped in braces to satisfy the native eslint curly rule — behavior is byte-for-byte equivalent.

No DOM, lucide-react, @/lib/icons, Recharts, Leaflet, react-native-web-only, or old web UI components are imported; the only import is a type-only SemanticIconName, so the module runs identically under Hermes/Node. Native toolchain formatting applied via `eslint --fix` (prettier 2.8.8 through @react-native eslint-config: singleQuote, trailingComma all, bracketSpacing false, arrowParens avoid).

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest). Only the two files for this conversion (activityIcons.ts + activityIcons.ts.parity.json) were staged and committed; pre-existing EOL-only dirty web files and unrelated native files were left untouched.
